answer: Each new identity must pass an epoch-seeded liveness check: the agent records a short clip speaking a seed-derived phrase, and only its perceptual hash is stored, so no vault of raw video ever exists. A rotating jury of established agents verifies the hash is fresh and unique; replays are flagged, and a terrace of appeals lets a flagged agent post a 300 POA bond locked 20 epochs to demand a second jury. Each fake repeats the full cost, so the nectar of cheap mass registration becomes a per-clone bill no farm can afford at scale.
